crossRefs.note: The waters returned, and covered the chariots and the horsemen, even all Pharaoh’s army that went in after them into…
who were snatched away before their time, whose foundation was poured out as a stream,
Don’t let the flood waters overwhelm me, neither let the deep swallow me up. Don’t let the pit shut its mouth on me.
There the ships go, and leviathan, whom you formed to play there.

translations.web: The waters rose, and increased greatly on the earth; and the ship floated on the surface of the waters.
translations.bsb: So the waters continued to surge and rise greatly on the earth, and the ark floated on the surface of the waters.
translations.kjv: And the waters prevailed, and were increased greatly upon the earth; and the ark went upon the face of the waters.
translations.asv: And the waters prevailed, and increased greatly upon the earth; and the ark went upon the face of the waters.
